

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let payload = String::from("owned once");





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    (tx).send(payload).await


}
 => {

},



    


_ = async {
    ()
}
 => {

},



}





print!("{}", payload);




drop(rx);




});



    
}
